caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical object with a round, dark green base and a vertical central support. From the central hub at the top of the support, six green cylindrical arms extend outward in a radial arrangement, each arm evenly spaced around a full circle. Each arm has a few yellow or brass-colored pegs or pins protruding from small holes along its length. The drawing uses shades of green, black, yellow, and gray for detail, and is enclosed within a rectangular border on a light tan or off-white background. The artwork is signed "Florence Truelson" in the lower right corner within the bordered area.
title: Reel
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
